is_anopheles.evidence: Study evaluated Anopheles gambiae s.l. collected in Bomi County, Liberia (Page 1, Abstract; Page 3, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Screened for Vgsc 1014F (L995F) and 1014S (L995S) kdr mutations using TaqMan assays (Page 3, Methods; Table 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 5 (Page 6) reports exact genotype counts (LL, LF, FF) for 169 An. gambiae mosquitoes tested in IRS and DL cone bioassays.

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae were collected from four field sites in Bomi County, Liberia between July and September 2011 and reared to adults (Page 3, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical study reporting original bioassay and molecular genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Detailed collection site locations and UTM X-Y coordinates in Bomi County, Liberia are provided in Table 1 (Page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito larval collections took place weekly from July to September 2011 (Page 3, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: No evidence of sample overlap with external datasets; reports novel primary field survey data from 2011.

supplement.evidence: All primary genotype frequency and counts data are present in Table 5 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This primary study reports on pyrethroid susceptibility and Vgsc 1014F/1014S kdr allele frequencies in field-derived Anopheles gambiae from Bomi County, Liberia collected in 2011. Genotype counts (LL, LF, FF) are provided for 169 mosquitoes stratified by survival status in deltamethrin cone bioassays.
